extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners and patent applicants / patent practitioners (attorneys, agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Consolidated USPTO form paragraphs and MPEP guidance on formal requirements for drawings, specifications, information disclosure statements, electronic media, and related filing/correction procedures during U.S. patent prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject Matter Admits of Illustration (drawing required)
rubrics_metrics.description: The subject matter of the application admits of illustration by a drawing; applicant is required to furnish a drawing under 37 CFR 1.81(c). No new matter may be introduced in the required drawing. Each drawing sheet submitted after the filing date must be labeled in the top margin as either 'Replacement Sheet' or 'New Sheet' pursuant to 37 CFR 1.121(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is given a TWO MONTH time period to submit a drawing in compliance with 37 CFR 1.81; extensions under 37 CFR 1.136(a) are available. Failure to timely submit will result in ABANDONMENT. Use of this form paragraph should be extremely rare (only where no examination can be performed due to lack of an illustration). When requiring drawings before examination use form paragraph 6.23.01 with a PTOL-90 or PTO-90C cover sheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color Photographs/Color Drawings (petition required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Color photographs and color drawings are not accepted in utility applications unless a petition under 37 CFR 1.84(a)(2) is granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petition must be accompanied by fee per 37 CFR 1.17(h), one set of color drawings/photos if submitted via EFS-Web or three sets if not via EFS-Web, and an amendment inserting a specified paragraph in the brief description of the drawings stating that at least one drawing is in color and copies will be provided on request upon payment of fee. Color photographs may be accepted if conditions for color drawings and black and white photographs are satisfied (see 37 CFR 1.84(b)(2)). Use only if the drawings required by 37 CFR 1.81 are in color. Do not use in design applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings Do Not Permit Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings are not of sufficient quality to permit examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replacement drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) are required in reply to the Office action. Replacement sheets should be labeled 'Replacement Sheet' in the page header (per 37 CFR 1.84(c)). Applicant is given a TWO MONTH time period to submit new drawings; extensions under 37 CFR 1.136(a) may be obtained. Failure to timely submit replacement sheets will result in ABANDONMENT. Applicant must also provide a marked-up copy of any amended drawing figure (annotated sheet) showing changes made. Encouraged to submit corrected drawings before allowance to avoid reduction of term adjustment per 37 CFR 1.704(c)(10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for Marked-up Copy of Drawing Corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to replacement sheets containing the corrected drawing figure(s), applicant is required to submit a marked-up copy of each Replacement Sheet including annotations indicating the changes made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The marked-up copy must be clearly labeled 'Annotated Sheet' and must be presented in the amendment or remarks section explaining the changes. Failure to timely submit the corrected drawing and marked-up copy will result in abandonment. Examiner Note: when used, applicant must provide marked-up copy and annotations per 37 CFR 1.121(d)(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Idiomatic English (substitute specification requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: A substitute specification in proper idiomatic English and in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52(a) and (b) is required. The substitute specification filed must be accompanied by a statement that it contains no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the original text is not in idiomatic English or violates 1.52 formatting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute Specification Required by Examiner (format and markings)
rubrics_metrics.description: A substitute specification required pursuant to 37 CFR 1.125(a) must not contain new matter and must be submitted with markings showing all changes relative to the immediate prior version of the specification of record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added text must be shown by underlining; deleted text by strikethrough (or double brackets for small deletions if strikethrough is hard to perceive); supply an accompanying clean version (without markings) and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter. Numbering paragraphs of the specification is not considered a change that must be shown. Use of this form paragraph should be extremely rare.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute Specification Not Entered (nonconforming to 1.125(b)/(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: A substitute specification filed has not been entered because it does not conform to 37 CFR 1.125(b) and (c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert a statement of why improper (e.g., missing statement of lack of new matter, missing marked-up copy, clean copy not supplied, filed in reissue or reexamination, filed after payment of issue fee, or contains claims). Substitute specifications filed after final action or appeal are governed by 37 CFR 1.116; those filed after mailing of a notice of allowance are governed by 37 CFR 1.312.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification Spacing of Lines
rubrics_metrics.description: The spacing of lines of the specification is such as to make reading difficult.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New application papers with lines 1 1/2 or double spaced on good quality paper are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numerous Errors in Specification (35 U.S.C. 112 compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: 35 U.S.C. 112(a) requires the specification to be written in 'full, clear, concise, and exact terms.' The specification is replete with terms which are not clear, concise, and exact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The specification should be carefully revised to comply with 35 U.S.C. 112(a) (or pre-AIA 112). Examples of unclear, inexact, or verbose terms should be identified and corrected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lengthy Specification (insufficiently checked)
rubrics_metrics.description: The lengthy specification has not been checked to the extent necessary to determine the presence of all possible minor errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant’s cooperation is requested in correcting any errors of which applicant becomes aware in the specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Papers Must Be Legible (formatting and font requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: The specification (including abstract and claims) and any amendments must have text written plainly and legibly by typewriter or machine printer in a nonscript type font (e.g., Arial, Times Roman, Courier).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferably font size 12; capital letters at least 0.3175 cm (0.125 in) high, but may be no smaller than 0.21 cm (0.08 in) (e.g., font size 6) in portrait orientation; only a single column of text. Presentation must permit direct reproduction of legible copies by photographic, electrostatic, photo-offset, microfilming, or electronic capture (OCR). See 37 CFR 1.52(a) and (b). If illegible, require a legible substitute spec in compliance with 1.52(a),(b) and 1.125.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings Must Show Every Claimed Feature (1.83(a) objection)
rubrics_metrics.description: The drawings are objected to under 37 CFR 1.83(a): the drawings must show every feature of the invention specified in the claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a feature is not shown, it must be shown or canceled from the claims. No new matter should be entered. Corrected replacement drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) required; replacement sheets should include all figures on the immediate prior version even if only one amended. Amended figure/figure number must not be labeled 'amended.' If a drawing figure is canceled, remove it and renumber remaining figures and adjust brief description of drawings accordingly. Each drawing sheet submitted after filing must be labeled 'Replacement Sheet' or 'New Sheet' per 1.121(d). Objection to drawings will not be held in abeyance. Failure to timely submit corrected drawings will void the application by abandonment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustration of 'Prior Art' (designation and labeling)
rubrics_metrics.description: A figure that illustrates only prior art should be designated by a legend such as '--Prior Art--' because only that which is old is illustrated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrected drawings in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) are required; replacement sheets should be labeled 'Replacement Sheet' in the page header. Objection to the drawings will not be held in abeyance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgment of Replacement Drawing Sheets (acceptability)
rubrics_metrics.description: The drawings were received on [date]. These drawings are acceptable or unacceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unacceptable because of noncompliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d), an explanation must be provided. Form PTOL-324 may be used instead of this form paragraph to provide the explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. PTO Does Not Make Drawing Changes
rubrics_metrics.description: The United States Patent and Trademark Office does not make drawing changes; it is applicant’s responsibility to ensure drawings are corrected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this form paragraph whenever the applicant has filed a request for the Office to make drawing changes. Form paragraph 6.40 (information on how to effect drawing changes) must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: How To Effect Drawing Changes (replacement/annotated sheets; timing; identification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Replacement drawing sheets must be presented incorporating desired changes and complying with 37 CFR 1.84. An explanation of changes must be presented in the drawing amendments or remarks section. Each drawing sheet submitted after filing must be labeled 'Replacement Sheet' or 'New Sheet' pursuant to 37 CFR 1.121(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A replacement sheet must include all figures on the immediate prior version even if only one figure is amended. Amended figures must not be labeled 'amended.' Annotated/marked-up copies of amended figures indicating changes may be submitted or required; such annotated sheets must be labeled 'Annotated Sheet' and presented in the amendment or remarks section. Timing: applicant must submit acceptable corrected drawings within the time period set in the Office action (see 37 CFR 1.85(a)); failure results in ABANDONMENT. If corrected drawings are required in a Notice of Allowability (PTOL-37), new drawings MUST be filed within the THREE MONTH shortened statutory period (no extensions under 1.136). Identifying indicia (title, inventor name, application number/docket) should be placed on the front of each sheet within the top margin if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reminder: USPTO Does Not Make Drawing Changes (follow-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant is reminded that the USPTO does not make drawing changes and that it is applicant’s responsibility to ensure drawings are corrected in accordance with prior instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when applicant has been previously provided information on how to effect drawing changes. Form paragraph 6.40 should follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reminder: Applicant Must Make Drawing Changes to Avoid Abandonment
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant is reminded that, to avoid abandonment, drawings must be corrected in accordance with instructions set forth in prior mailed paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph is used when allowing the application and applicant has previously been provided information on how to effect drawing changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings Contain Informalities; Application Allowed (subject to correction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings filed are acceptable subject to correction of indicated informalities. Correction required in reply to the Office action to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correction will not be held in abeyance. Use when allowing the application, particularly at time of first action issue. Follow with form paragraph 6.40 or 6.41.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner's Amendment Involving Drawing Changes (applicant obligations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner-approved changes to the drawings that are agreed upon by applicant must be made by applicant to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert the agreed-upon drawing changes in the communication. Form paragraphs 6.39 and 6.40 must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model/Exhibit/Specimen - Applicant Must Make Arrangements for Return
rubrics_metrics.description: A model, exhibit, or specimen is no longer necessary for conduct of business before the Office; applicant must arrange for its return at applicant's expense in accordance with 37 CFR 1.94(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is given TWO MONTHS from mailing date to arrange return to avoid disposal under 37 CFR 1.94(c). Extensions available under 1.136 except for perishables. Applicant responsible for retaining actual model/exhibit/specimen for enforceable life of any patent unless exceptions in 1.94(b) apply. Office will dispose of perishables without notice unless applicant requested return upon submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement (IDS) Not Considered (general noncompliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: An IDS filed fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.97, 1.98 and MPEP § 609 because of specified deficiencies; it has been placed in the application file but the information referred to therein has not been considered as to the merits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The date of any resubmission or submission of missing elements will be the date of submission for determining compliance with timing and statement requirements of 1.97. See MPEP § 609.05(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered — After First Action, No Statement (37 CFR 1.97(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: IDS fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.97(c) because it lacks a statement as specified in 37 CFR 1.97(e). It has been placed in the application file but not considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used after first action but before prosecution closes when required statement missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered — No Fee (37 CFR 1.17(p))
rubrics_metrics.description: IDS filed fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.97(c) because it lacks the fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(p). It has been placed in the application file but the information referred to therein has not been considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used after first action but before prosecution closes (or other referenced procedural timings) when fee missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered After Prosecution Closed — No Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: IDS filed after prosecution closed lacks the statement required by 37 CFR 1.97(e) (governed by 1.97(d)), and therefore the information has not been considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place in file but not considered; references to governing rules and timing apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered After Prosecution Closed — No Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: IDS filed after prosecution closed lacks the fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(p) and has not been considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place in file but not considered; applicant must supply missing fee or information.

rubrics_metrics.name: References Listed in Specification Are Not a Proper IDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing references in the specification is not a proper information disclosure statement. 37 CFR 1.98(b) requires a list of all patents, publications, applications, or other information submitted on a separate paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unless references have been cited by the examiner on form PTO-892, they have not been considered. The list may not be incorporated into the specification but must be submitted in a separate paper. See MPEP § 609.04(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered — No Copy of References (37 CFR 1.98(a)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: The IDS fails to include legible copies as required by 37 CFR 1.98(a)(2) of each cited foreign patent document, each non-patent literature publication or the portion that caused listing, and other required information. It has been placed in the file but not considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use this form paragraph when the missing references are U.S. patents, U.S. patent application publications, or U.S. pending applications stored in the Image File Wrapper (IFW).

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Not Considered — Non-compliant List of References
rubrics_metrics.description: The IDS contains a non-compliant list of references (does not meet 37 CFR 1.98(a)(1) format or content requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include lists copied from other applications or missing required columns/heading. Such IDS has been placed in the file but the information has not been considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time for Completing IDS — Missing Required Elements (37 CFR 1.98(a)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: The IDS fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.98(a)(1), which requires: (1) a list of all patents/publications/applications or other information submitted for consideration; (2) U.S. patents and U.S. patent application publications listed separately from other documents; (3) the application number on each page of the list; (4) a column providing space for examiner initials next to each document; and (5) a heading clearly indicating that the list is an IDS. The IDS has been placed in the application file but not considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an IDS listing includes an initialed IDS listing from another application it would not comply. If omissions are inadvertent and the IDS otherwise complies with timing under 1.97, applicant is given ONE (1) MONTH from the date of the notice to supply omissions/corrections; NO EXTENSION may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a) or (b). Failure to timely comply results in the IDS being placed in the file with non-complying information not considered. This practice does not apply where deliberate omission occurred or timing requirements not met.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS Filed After Prosecution Closed but in Compliance with 1.97 (considered)
rubrics_metrics.description: An IDS submitted after the mailing date of a final Office action/Notice of Allowance/Ex parte Quayle action was filed in compliance with 37 CFR 1.97 and is being considered by the examiner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert appropriate dates and identify the type of prior mailing.

rubrics_metrics.name: References from PCT International Search Report — Not Printed on Resulting Patent (371 applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: References cited in the PCT international search report have been considered but will not be listed on any patent resulting from the application because they were not provided on a separate list in compliance with 37 CFR 1.98(a)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To have references printed on the resulting patent, a separate listing (preferably on PTO/SB/08A and 08B) must be filed within the set period for reply to the Office action (use prior to allowance). Instead of using this paragraph, the examiner may list the references on a PTO-892 to notify applicant they have been considered and will be printed.

rubrics_metrics.name: References from PCT Search Report — Ready for Allowance (371 applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: References cited in the PCT international search report have been considered but will not be listed on the resulting patent because not provided on a separate list in compliance with 37 CFR 1.98(a)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To have the references printed, file the separate listing (preferably PTO/SB/08A and 08B) within ONE MONTH of the mailing date of this communication. NO EXTENSION under 37 CFR 1.136(a) or (b) will be granted.

rubrics_metrics.name: References Not Considered in 35 U.S.C. 371 Applications (PCT list insufficient)
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing of references in the PCT international search report is not a proper IDS complying with 37 CFR 1.98. Required legible copies (foreign patents, publications, pending U.S. app specs/drawings, other info) and a separate list per 1.98(a)(1) and (b) are required. Therefore, references in the international search report have not been considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is advised the date of submission of any item or missing element will be the date of submission for purposes of timing and 37 CFR 1.97(e) statements. Do not use when missing references are U.S. patents, U.S. patent application publications, or U.S. pending applications stored in IFW. Used in national stage 35 U.S.C. 371 applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: CD-ROM/CD-R Requirements — No Statement that CDs are Identical
rubrics_metrics.description: Application is objected to under 37 CFR 1.52(e)(4) because it does not contain a statement in the transmittal letter that the two compact discs are identical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correction required by applicant.

rubrics_metrics.name: CD-ROM/CD-R Requirements — Transmittal Letter Missing Listing/Format Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Application contains a data file on CD-ROM/CD-R but the transmittal letter does not list for each CD the machine format, operating system compatibility, list of files with names, sizes in bytes, dates of creation, and any other special information necessary to identify and interpret the information per 37 CFR 1.52(e)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A statement listing the required information is required in the transmittal letter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification Lacking List of Compact Discs and Associated Files
rubrics_metrics.description: Portions of the application are contained on compact disc(s) but the paper portion of the specification does not identify the compact disc(s) and list the files including name, file size, and creation date on each disc as required by 37 CFR 1.52(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is required to amend the specification to identify each disc and the files contained on each disc including file name, file size, and file creation date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification Lacking Incorporation-by-Reference Statement for Compact Disc or Text File Submitted via EFS-Web
rubrics_metrics.description: Application contains compact disc(s) or text file(s) submitted via EFS-Web as part of originally filed subject matter but does not contain an incorporation-by-reference statement for the compact disc(s) or text file(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant(s) are required to insert the appropriate incorporation-by-reference statement in the specification. See 37 CFR 1.77(b)(5) and MPEP § 502.05.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table Column/Row Relationship Not Maintained (ASCII tables)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables submitted in ASCII text format (via EFS-Web or on compact disc) must maintain the spatial orientation of cell entries; the submitted table does not maintain data in proper row/column alignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is required to submit a replacement text file via EFS-Web or on compact disc with the table data properly aligned. Use when data cannot be accurately read because cell alignments are lost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data File on CD-ROM/CD-R Not in ASCII File Format
rubrics_metrics.description: Application contains a data file on CD-ROM/CD-R that is not in an ASCII file format in violation of 37 CFR 1.52(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant is required to resubmit file(s) in ASCII format. No new matter may be introduced when presenting file(s) in ASCII format. Use when files are proprietary formats (e.g., Word, Excel) or contain non-ASCII characters; specify file name and nature of non-compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table Less Than 51 Pages Submitted Only as Text File (not permitted)
rubrics_metrics.description: A table in the description consisting of less than fifty-one (51) pages was submitted only in ASCII text format; under 37 CFR 1.52(e) only tables of at least 51 pages may be submitted as ASCII text files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant must cancel references to the table in text format in the specification, file a paper version of the table in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52 or file a PDF version via EFS-Web, and change all references to the former table in the remainder of the specification. Insert range of pages referencing the table in the communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Program Listing Appendix >300 Lines (must be submitted as appendix)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the specification contains a computer program listing of more than three hundred (300) lines, in accordance with 37 CFR 1.96(c) the listing must be submitted as an appendix in text format (via EFS-Web or on compact disc conforming to 1.96(c)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The computer program listing appendix must be appropriately referenced in the specification (see 37 CFR 1.77(b)(5)). Applicant required to cancel the current in-specification program listing, file the listing appendix as a text file via EFS-Web or on compact disc in compliance with 1.96(c), and insert an appropriate reference to the newly added appendix at the beginning of the specification. Use whenever program listing >300 lines included as part of descriptive portion of the specification (filed on or after Sept 8, 2000).

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Program Listing as Printout Within Specification (heading present)
rubrics_metrics.description: Heading: 'Computer Program Listing as Printout Within the Specification (More Than 60 Lines And Not More Than Three Hundred Lines)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content following this heading is truncated in the source chunk; the guidance likely addresses requirements for program listings between 60 and 300 lines when included as printout within the specification. (Full guidance not present in this chunk.)
